failure_reason: Site began rate-limiting (HTTP 429) mid-session after several successful requests; per protocol the first block stops further requests to this host, so a set of category-specific '<X> Clearance' candidate pages found in navigation could not be opened/verified and are only documented in notes, not included as rows.
notes: ACCESS: direct HTTP via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome); robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. DISCOVERY: the main nav 'Sale' item (https://www.wayfair.com/daily-sales) is the site's sale/deals hub. A homepage promo module links directly to https://www.wayfair.com/daily-sales/clearance. Opened it: it is a genuine paginated product listing (DailySalesEventPage/eventbrowse template). ITS <title> IS 'Wayfair Clearance & Open Box Deals' and its <meta name=description> reads 'Shop Wayfair clearance for open box deals and save big on furniture, decor, and more...' - i.e. the site's own title tag and URL slug (/daily-sales/clearance) explicitly and repeatedly use the word 'Clearance'. HOWEVER the page's own on-page H1 reads 'Open Box' (not 'Clearance') and its SSR tracking JSON identifies the underlying content as eventName='open-box', eventId=2 (not an eventName containing 'clearance') - i.e. Wayfair appears to be serving its 'Open Box' (returned/refurbished/overstock) inventory AS the current content behind the /clearance URL slug, rather than maintaining a separately-labeled Clearance dataset. This is a genuine, on-page-observed Sale-vs-Clearance ambiguity per the brief's critical test, so it is recorded with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than a confident yes/no. SEPARATELY EXCLUDED: /flashdeals (main-nav-adjacent, H1='Flash Deals', generic Wayfair homepage title/meta with no clearance/outlet/permanence signal at all - a textbook temporary promotional deals page per the brief's exclusion list, totalSKUCount=8366 but not recorded as Clearance). UNVERIFIED CANDIDATES (found via real navigation, not search, but not opened due to the 429 block, so NOT included as rows): the /daily-sales hub page itself links to ten distinct category-scoped pages whose titles literally contain the word 'Clearance' - area-rug-clearance~e371602, bathroom-vanities-&-more-on-clearance~e371604, bedding-clearance~e371606, bedroom-furniture-clearance~e371608, kitchen-&-dining-furniture-clearance~e371622, lighting-clearance~e371626, living-room-seating-clearance~e371628, mattresses-&-more-on-clearance~e371632, outdoor-furniture-clearance~e371638, outdoor-lighting-&-decor-clearance~e371662 (all under https://www.wayfair.com/daily-sales/). These are plausible genuine children of Clearance (explicit 'Clearance' naming), but their sequential event IDs (371602-371670) sit immediately adjacent to other event IDs on the same hub that are clearly temporary seasonal campaigns (labor-day-sale, doorbuster-deals~e371670, classic-summer-tabletop~e361108), so it is also plausible they are all part of one time-limited seasonal clearance campaign rather than an evergreen taxonomy - genuinely could not resolve this without opening them, which the block prevented. None of these ten links were found inside the /daily-sales/clearance page's own SSR HTML (checked - not present), so they are not confirmed structural children of that specific parent page; they are only confirmed to be reachable from the broader /daily-sales hub. Recommend a follow-up pass to open these ten URLs directly once access is available. Only one row could be confidently recorded as an opened, real PLP.
